title: The player's city
theme: Reactions to what the player builds, plus displacement and closures: homes demolished, workplaces removed, new people moving in.

storylets.title: The first ride on the new line
storylets.note: Reacts to the player opening a metro line. Curious first rides.

A.desc: an adult at the metro entrance

b1: {A} stands at the station entrance and studies the fresh paint on the sign.
{A} lingers at the mouth of the new line, hands in {A.his} pockets.
{A} stops in front of the entrance and reads the route map twice.
b2: {A} points at the line map and traces it with one finger.
{A} gestures up at the lift shaft and the lit platform above.
{A} points out the new line to a passerby and shrugs.
b3: {A} boards a train on the new line and the doors hiss shut.
{A} takes the lift up to the platform and boards. The train pulls out.
{A} takes the first train on the line and is gone.

log: Overheard: {A} says: "Ten minutes to the foundry now. Used to be forty."
Overheard: {A} says: "They did not skimp on the lights, I will say that."

storylets.title: A door that is no longer there
storylets.note: The player demolishes a home. The resident is shown carrying what they can. Hearsay carries the rest. Sets the chain flag A:displaced.

A.desc: an adult with all their things

b1: {A} stands at a stretch of bare ground where a door used to be.
{A} stays on the empty plot, turning slowly in place.
{A} stands before a cleared lot with a crate at {A.his} feet.
b2: {A} gathers {A.his} belongings into crates on the bare ground.
{A} ties a rolled mattress with cord and hoists it onto one shoulder.
{A} carries a lamp and a bundle of clothes from the rubble.
b3: {A} carries a stack of belongings away down the block, looking back once.
{A} walks off with a bundle on each shoulder.
{A} heads for the metro, dragging a crate.

log: Overheard: {A} says: "A week's notice. Then the drones came."
Overheard: {A} says: "Everything I own is right here. That's the whole story."

lines: Overheard: {S} says to {L} that {A.desc} lost {A.his} apartment when the building came down. A week's notice and gone.

Overheard: {S} says {A.desc} lost {A.his} place to the demolition and is staying with someone now.
Overheard: {S} mentions to {L} that {A.desc} had to clear out before the demolition.
entry: Lost a place to live when the building was demolished, per {S} (overheard).
Had to leave after the demolition, per {S} (overheard, in conversation).
Was displaced by the wrecking crew, said {S} (overheard).
